#Flow Marker processing (trimming names)
```{r}
# Store Original Full Column Names Before Trimming
original_flow_names <- colnames(flow_data)

# Trim Flow Marker Names for Processing
trim_marker_name <- function(marker) {
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(marker, "_"))  # Split by "_"
  if (length(parts) >= 2) {
    return(paste(parts[1:2], collapse = "_"))  # Keep only the first two parts
  } else {
    return(marker)  # Return original if no second underscore
  }
}

# Create a Mapping of Trimmed to Full Names
trimmed_flow_names <- sapply(original_flow_names, trim_marker_name)
name_mapping <- data.frame(Full_Name = original_flow_names, Trimmed_Name = trimmed_flow_names, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Apply Trimmed Names to Flow Data
colnames(flow_data) <- trimmed_flow_names

```

#Merging dataset, seasonality and filtering 
```{r}
# Merge Data
merged_data <- flow_data %>%
  left_join(clinical_data, by = "ID") %>%
  left_join(pca_data, by = "ID") 

# Compute Seasonal Variables
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    dayssincejan2019 = as.numeric(as.POSIXct(DATE_VISIT, format="%Y-%m-%d") - as.POSIXct("2019-01-01")),
    season_sin = sin((2 * pi * dayssincejan2019) / 365.2425),
    season_cos = cos((2 * pi * dayssincejan2019) / 365.2425),
    SEX_BIRTH = as.factor(SEX_BIRTH),
    ETHNICITY = as.factor(ETHNICITY),
    CENTER_RUMC = as.integer(CENTER == "RUMC")
  )


# ================================
# Ethnicity and Center Dummies
# ================================
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    ASIAN    = as.numeric(ETHNICITY == "Asian"),
    BLACK    = as.numeric(ETHNICITY == "Black"),
    WHITE    = as.numeric(ETHNICITY == "White"),
    CENTER_RUMC = as.numeric(CENTER == "RUMC")
  )

# Filter Out "EC_persistent" from CONTROLLER_1B
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  filter(Tropism %in% c("X4", "R5")) %>%
 filter(CONTROLLER_1B != "EC_persistent")



merged_data$Tropism <- factor(merged_data$Tropism, levels = c("R5", "X4"))


# Define Covariates
covariate_columns <- c("AGE", "SEX_BIRTH", "TIMETOLAB", "season_sin", "season_cos", "CENTER_RUMC", "CD4_NADIR", "COVID_VACC")

# Remove Rows with Missing Covariates
merged_data <- merged_data %>% drop_na(all_of(covariate_columns))
```

```{r}
# ================================
# Custom scree plot function
# ================================

plot_scree_custom <- function(pca_obj, title, n_dims = 25, pc_cutoff = 5) {

  n_dims  <- min(n_dims, nrow(pca_obj$eig))
  eig_vals <- pca_obj$eig[1:n_dims, ]
  dims     <- 1:n_dims
  pct      <- eig_vals[, 2]
  cum_pct  <- eig_vals[, 3]

  cutoff_cum <- cum_pct[pc_cutoff]

  df <- data.frame(
    Dimension  = dims,
    Variance   = pct,
    Cumulative = cum_pct
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Dimension)) +
    geom_bar(aes(y = Variance), stat = "identity",
             fill = "steelblue3", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Variance), color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Variance), color = "black", size = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Cumulative), color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Cumulative), color = "grey50", size = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = pc_cutoff, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = cutoff_cum, linetype = "dotted",
               color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text",
             x     = pc_cutoff + 0.5,
             y     = max(pct) * 0.95,
             label = paste0("PC", pc_cutoff, "\n(cum. ", round(cutoff_cum, 1), "%)"),
             hjust = 0, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(y = Variance,
                  label = paste0(round(Variance, 1), "%")),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = dims) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name     = "Percentage of explained variance",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = "Cumulative variance (%)")
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Dimensions") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

# ================================
# PCA regression heatmap function
# ================================

plot_PCA_regression <- function(pca, meta_data, meta_variables,
                                title = "PC contribution") {

  pca_res <- as.data.frame(pca$ind$coord[, 1:5, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(pca_res) <- paste0("Flow_PC", 1:ncol(pca_res))

  meta_variables_present <- meta_variables[meta_variables %in% colnames(meta_data)]

  pca_adj_r_sq <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(meta_variables_present),
    ncol = ncol(pca_res)
  )
  rownames(pca_adj_r_sq) <- meta_variables_present
  colnames(pca_adj_r_sq) <- colnames(pca_res)

  for (i in seq_len(ncol(pca_res))) {
    for (j in seq_along(meta_variables_present)) {

      var_name <- meta_variables_present[j]

      tmp <- data.frame(
        pc_value = as.numeric(pca_res[[i]]),
        covar    = meta_data[[var_name]]
      )
      tmp <- tmp[complete.cases(tmp), , drop = FALSE]

      if (nrow(tmp) < 10 || length(unique(tmp$covar)) < 2) {
        pca_adj_r_sq[j, i] <- NA_real_
        next
      }

      if (is.character(tmp$covar) || is.factor(tmp$covar)) {
        tmp$covar <- as.factor(tmp$covar)
      } else {
        tmp$covar <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tmp$covar))
      }

      tmp <- tmp[complete.cases(tmp), , drop = FALSE]

      if (nrow(tmp) < 10 || length(unique(tmp$covar)) < 2) {
        pca_adj_r_sq[j, i] <- NA_real_
        next
      }

      fit <- tryCatch(
        lm(pc_value ~ covar, data = tmp),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (!is.null(fit)) {
        pca_adj_r_sq[j, i] <- as.numeric(summary(fit)$adj.r.squared)
      }
    }
  }

  storage.mode(pca_adj_r_sq) <- "numeric"

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    pca_adj_r_sq,
    cluster_rows    = FALSE,
    cluster_cols    = FALSE,
    show_rownames   = TRUE,
    show_colnames   = TRUE,
    scale           = "none",
    main            = title,
    display_numbers = TRUE,
    number_format   = "%.2f",
    fontsize        = 12,
    fontsize_number = 10,
    color  = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50),
    breaks = seq(-0.5, 0.5, length.out = 51)
  )
}

# ================================
# Residualized flow matrix after correction
# ================================

covariates_for_correction <- c(
  "AGE", "SEX_BIRTH", "TIMETOLAB",
  "season_sin", "season_cos",
  "CENTER_RUMC", "COVID_VACC"
)

covariates_for_correction <- covariates_for_correction[
  covariates_for_correction %in% colnames(pca_meta)
]

residual_matrix <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(pca_meta),
  ncol = ncol(selected_columns_pca)
)
colnames(residual_matrix) <- colnames(selected_columns_pca)
rownames(residual_matrix) <- pca_meta$ID

for (marker_col in colnames(selected_columns_pca)) {

  model_df <- data.frame(
    row_id = seq_len(nrow(pca_meta)),
    marker = selected_columns_pca[[marker_col]],
    pca_meta[, covariates_for_correction, drop = FALSE]
  )
  model_df <- model_df[complete.cases(model_df), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(model_df) < 10 || sd(model_df$marker, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) next

  fit <- tryCatch(
    lm(
      as.formula(paste("marker ~",
                       paste(covariates_for_correction, collapse = " + "))),
      data = model_df
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    residual_matrix[model_df$row_id, marker_col] <- residuals(fit)
  }
}

residuals_df <- residuals_df[, colSums(!is.na(residuals_df)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
```

#ASSUMPTION CHECK
```{r}
# ================================
# FLOW PCA regression assumption checks
# Reviewer response:
# Normality, homoscedasticity, and linearity
#
# Models: Flow PC score ~ covariate
#
# Outputs:
# 1) Q-Q plots: normality
# 2) Residuals vs fitted: homoscedasticity
# 3) Residuals vs fitted for continuous covariates only: linearity
#    with natural cubic spline smoother, not LOESS
# ================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(FactoMineR)
  library(lmtest)
  library(splines)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(ggplot2)
})

out_dir <- "R:/hcrc/Personal folders/Kavita Mehta/2000HIV/2000HIV_Flow/Percentage/PCA_assumption_checks"

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ================================
# If PCA objects are not already available, recreate them
# ================================

if (!exists("selected_columns_pca") || !exists("pca_meta")) {
  
  pca_df <- merged_data_discovery
  
  pca_df[pca_df == -Inf] <- NA
  pca_df[pca_df == Inf]  <- NA
  
  start_marker <- "Panel1_1012"
  end_marker   <- "Panel3_3116"
  
  start_index <- which(colnames(pca_df) == start_marker)
  end_index   <- which(colnames(pca_df) == end_marker)
  
  if (length(start_index) == 0 || length(end_index) == 0) {
    stop("Could not find start_marker or end_marker in pca_df.")
  }
  
  flow_columns <- colnames(pca_df)[start_index:end_index]
  
  selected_columns <- pca_df[, flow_columns, drop = FALSE] %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  
  selected_columns <- selected_columns[, colSums(!is.na(selected_columns)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  selected_columns <- selected_columns[, apply(selected_columns, 2, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0), drop = FALSE]
  
  complete_rows <- complete.cases(selected_columns)
  
  selected_columns_pca <- selected_columns[complete_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  pca_meta <- pca_df[complete_rows, , drop = FALSE]
}

# ================================
# Covariates used for flow PCA-based confounder assessment
# ================================

all_covariates_to_check <- c(
  "AGE",
  "SEX_BIRTH",
  "TIMETOLAB",
  "season_sin",
  "season_cos",
  "CENTER_RUMC",
  "COVID_VACC"
)

# ================================
# Continuous covariates only
# Linearity is assessed only for these
# ================================

continuous_covariates <- c(
  "AGE",
  "TIMETOLAB",
  "season_sin",
  "season_cos"
)

# Optional: include these if present and used in your flow PCA assessment
optional_continuous_covariates <- c(
  "BMI_BASELINE",
  "CD4_NADIR",
  "CD4CD8_PRECART",
  "VL_ZENITH"
)

all_covariates_to_check <- unique(c(
  all_covariates_to_check,
  optional_continuous_covariates[optional_continuous_covariates %in% colnames(pca_meta)]
))

continuous_covariates <- unique(c(
  continuous_covariates,
  optional_continuous_covariates[optional_continuous_covariates %in% colnames(pca_meta)]
))

# ================================
# PCA on original flow data
# ================================

mypca_flow_assumption <- PCA(selected_columns_pca, ncp = 10, graph = FALSE)

n_pc <- min(10, ncol(mypca_flow_assumption$ind$coord))

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(mypca_flow_assumption$ind$coord[, 1:n_pc, drop = FALSE])
colnames(pca_scores) <- paste0("Flow_PC", 1:n_pc)

analysis_df <- cbind(pca_scores, pca_meta)

all_covariates_to_check <- all_covariates_to_check[
  all_covariates_to_check %in% colnames(analysis_df)
]

continuous_covariates <- continuous_covariates[
  continuous_covariates %in% colnames(analysis_df)
]

# ================================
# Run assumption checks
# ================================

results <- list()
diagnostic_data <- list()

for (pc in paste0("Flow_PC", 1:n_pc)) {
  
  for (covar in all_covariates_to_check) {
    
    tmp <- analysis_df[, c(pc, covar)]
    tmp <- tmp[complete.cases(tmp), , drop = FALSE]
    
    if (nrow(tmp) < 20) next
    
    colnames(tmp) <- c("pc", "covar")
    
    tmp$pc <- as.numeric(tmp$pc)
    
    if (covar %in% continuous_covariates) {
      tmp$covar <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tmp$covar))
    } else {
      tmp$covar <- as.factor(tmp$covar)
    }
    
    tmp <- tmp[complete.cases(tmp), , drop = FALSE]
    
    if (nrow(tmp) < 20 || length(unique(tmp$covar)) < 2) next
    
    lm_fit <- tryCatch(
      lm(pc ~ covar, data = tmp),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (is.null(lm_fit)) next
    
    bp_p <- tryCatch(
      lmtest::bptest(lm_fit)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
    
    linearity_spline_p <- NA_real_
    
    if (covar %in% continuous_covariates && length(unique(tmp$covar)) >= 4) {
      
      spline_fit <- tryCatch(
        lm(pc ~ splines::ns(covar, df = 3), data = tmp),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (!is.null(spline_fit)) {
        linearity_spline_p <- tryCatch(
          anova(lm_fit, spline_fit)$`Pr(>F)`[2],
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      }
    }
    
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      PC = pc,
      Covariate = covar,
      Variable_Type = ifelse(
        covar %in% continuous_covariates,
        "Continuous",
        "Categorical"
      ),
      N = nrow(tmp),
      Adj_R2 = summary(lm_fit)$adj.r.squared,
      BreuschPagan_P = bp_p,
      Linearity_Spline_P = linearity_spline_p
    )
    
    diagnostic_data[[length(diagnostic_data) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      PC = pc,
      Covariate = covar,
      Variable_Type = ifelse(
        covar %in% continuous_covariates,
        "Continuous",
        "Categorical"
      ),
      Fitted = fitted(lm_fit),
      Residual = residuals(lm_fit),
      Std_Residual = rstandard(lm_fit)
    )
  }
}

results_df_flow <- bind_rows(results) %>%
  arrange(PC, Covariate)

diagnostics_df_flow <- bind_rows(diagnostic_data)

# ================================
# Save assumption test results
# ================================

write.xlsx(
  results_df_flow,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "Flow_PCA_Regression_Assumption_Checks.xlsx"),
  sheetName = "Assumption_Checks",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ================================
# Diagnostic plots
# Representative plots: Flow PC1-PC5 only
# ================================

pcs_for_plots <- paste0("Flow_PC", 1:min(5, n_pc))

diagnostics_plot_flow <- diagnostics_df_flow %>%
  filter(PC %in% pcs_for_plots)

# ================================
# 1) Q-Q plots
# Answer: normality of residuals
# ================================

qq_plot_flow <- ggplot(diagnostics_plot_flow, aes(sample = Std_Residual)) +
  stat_qq(size = 0.35, alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "red") +
  facet_grid(PC ~ Covariate, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 90),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Q-Q plots of standardized residuals",
    subtitle = "Assesses normality; Flow PCA regression models: Flow PC score ~ covariate",
    x = "Theoretical quantiles",
    y = "Standardized residuals"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "Flow_PCA_Regression_QQ_Plots_Normality_PC1_to_PC5.pdf"),
  plot = qq_plot_flow,
  width = 18,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "Flow_PCA_Regression_QQ_Plots_Normality_PC1_to_PC5.tiff"),
  plot = qq_plot_flow,
  width = 18,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 600,
  units = "in",
  device = "tiff"
)

# ================================
# 2) Residuals vs fitted plots
# Answer: homoscedasticity
# Include continuous + categorical covariates
# ================================

homoscedasticity_plot_flow <- ggplot(diagnostics_plot_flow, aes(x = Fitted, y = Residual)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.35, alpha = 0.5) +

  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Residuals versus fitted values",
    subtitle = "Assesses homoscedasticity; Flow PCA regression models: Flow PC score ~ covariate",
    x = "Fitted values",
    y = "Residuals"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "Flow_PCA_Regression_Residuals_vs_Fitted_Homoscedasticity_PC1_to_PC5.pdf"),
```

#Analysis in DISCOVERY cohort
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggrepel)

# Define Start and End Markers
start_marker <- "Panel1_1012"
end_marker <- "Panel3_3116"
start_index <- which(colnames(merged_data_discovery) == start_marker)
end_index <- which(colnames(merged_data_discovery) == end_marker)
flow_columns <- colnames(merged_data_discovery)[start_index:end_index]

# Inverse Rank Normalize
merged_data_discovery[flow_columns] <- lapply(merged_data_discovery[flow_columns], function(x) {
  qnorm((rank(x, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(x)))
})

# Define Covariates
covariates <- c("Tropism", "AGE", "SEX_BIRTH", "TIMETOLAB", "season_sin", "season_cos", "CENTER_RUMC", "COVID_VACC")

# Run linear regression using lm for each marker
results_list <- lapply(flow_columns, function(marker) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste(marker, "~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
  model <- lm(formula, data = merged_data_discovery)
  coef_summary <- summary(model)$coefficients
  if ("TropismX4" %in% rownames(coef_summary)) {
    return(data.frame(
      Cell_Population = marker,
      Coefficient = coef_summary["TropismX4", "Estimate"],
      P_Value = coef_summary["TropismX4", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    ))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
})

# Combine results
lm_results_df_discovery <- do.call(rbind, results_list) %>%
  mutate(Adjusted_P_Value = p.adjust(P_Value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(Adjusted_P_Value) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())


# Merge with Full Marker Names
lm_results_df_discovery <- lm_results_df_discovery %>%
  left_join(name_mapping, by = c("Cell_Population" = "Trimmed_Name")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Full_Name, Coefficient, P_Value, Adjusted_P_Value, rank) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cell_Population = Full_Name)

# Save results
write.xlsx(lm_results_df_discovery, "R:/hcrc/Personal folders/Kavita Mehta/2000HIV/2000HIV_Flow/Percentage/FlowCytometry_Results_discovery.xlsx")


# Define FDR threshold
fdr_threshold <- 0.05

# Create short labels after second underscore
lm_results_df_discovery <- lm_results_df_discovery %>%
  mutate(
    logP = -log10(Adjusted_P_Value),
    Significance = ifelse(Adjusted_P_Value < fdr_threshold, "Significant", "Not Significant"),
    Label_Short = sub("^(?:[^_]*_){2}", "", Cell_Population)
  )

# Volcano Plot
ggplot(lm_results_df_discovery, aes(x = Coefficient, y = logP, color = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(lm_results_df_discovery, Significance == "Significant"),
    aes(label = Label_Short),
    size = 4, max.overlaps = 50, force = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "red", "Not Significant" = "black")) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot of Flow Cytometry Markers (DISCOVERY COHORT)",
    x = "Log Fold Change (X4 vs R5)",
    y = "-log10(Adjusted P-Value)",
    color = "Significance Level"
  ) +
```

#heatmap
```{r}
# Load discovery and validation results
discovery_df <- read.xlsx("R:/hcrc/Personal folders/Kavita Mehta/2000HIV_Flow/Percentage/FlowCytometry_Results_discovery.xlsx")
validation_df <- read.xlsx("R:/hcrc/Personal folders/Kavita Mehta/2000HIV_Flow/Percentage/FlowCytometry_Results_validation.xlsx")

# Merge discovery and validation
merged_df <- discovery_df %>%
  select(Cell_Population, Coefficient_discovery = Coefficient, Adjusted_P_Value_discovery = Adjusted_P_Value) %>%
  left_join(
    validation_df %>%
      select(Cell_Population, Coefficient_validation = Coefficient, P_Value_validation = P_Value),
    by = "Cell_Population"
  )

# Restore full marker names if needed
merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  left_join(name_mapping, by = c("Cell_Population" = "Trimmed_Name")) %>%
  mutate(Cell_Population = ifelse(!is.na(Full_Name), Full_Name, Cell_Population)) %>%
  select(-Full_Name)

# Annotate significance
merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    Significance_Label = case_when(
      Adjusted_P_Value_discovery < 0.05 & P_Value_validation < 0.05 &
        sign(Coefficient_discovery) == sign(Coefficient_validation) ~ "**",
      Adjusted_P_Value_discovery < 0.05 & P_Value_validation >= 0.05 &
        sign(Coefficient_discovery) == sign(Coefficient_validation) ~ "*^",
      Adjusted_P_Value_discovery < 0.05 & P_Value_validation >= 0.05 &
        sign(Coefficient_discovery) != sign(Coefficient_validation) ~ "*#",
      Adjusted_P_Value_discovery < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# Define your markers and cells of interest
markers_of_interest <- c("PD1+", "CD38+", "HLA-DR+", "HLA-DR+CD38+", "CXCR5+","CXCR4+", "CCR4+","CCR5+")
cells_of_interest <- c("Treg", "mTreg", "nTreg","CD4+.Th1/17", "CD4+",  "CD4+.Tcm" , "CD4+.Th17", "CD4+.Th2", "CD4+.Th1", "CD4+.Tnaive","CD4+CD8-")

# Extract and clean Main_Population and Sub_Marker (NO regex lookbehind!)
merged_df_filtered <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    Main_Population = sub("^Panel\\d+_\\d+_", "", Cell_Population),      # Remove prefix
    Main_Population = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Main_Population),               # Remove marker at end
    Sub_Marker = sub(".*_", "", Cell_Population)                         # Extract last part
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Sub_Marker %in% markers_of_interest,
    Main_Population %in% cells_of_interest
  )

# Optional: Clean for plotting
merged_df_filtered$Main_Population <- gsub("_", " ", merged_df_filtered$Main_Population)
merged_df_filtered$Sub_Marker <- gsub("_", " ", merged_df_filtered$Sub_Marker)

# Optional: Order factors
merged_df_filtered$Main_Population <- factor(
  merged_df_filtered$Main_Population,
  levels = cells_of_interest
)
merged_df_filtered$Sub_Marker <- factor(
  merged_df_filtered$Sub_Marker,
  levels = markers_of_interest
)



# Step 1: Create all possible combinations
all_combinations <- expand_grid(
  Main_Population = unique(merged_df_filtered$Main_Population),
  Sub_Marker = unique(merged_df_filtered$Sub_Marker)
)

# Step 2: Merge with your filtered data
merged_full <- all_combinations %>%
  left_join(merged_df_filtered, by = c("Main_Population", "Sub_Marker"))
# Step 3: Plot
ggplot(merged_full, aes(x = Sub_Marker, y = Main_Population, fill = Coefficient_discovery)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5, width = 1.1, height = 1.1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Significance_Label), size = 6, color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "hotpink3", mid = "white", high = "deepskyblue", midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey80",  # grey for missing combinations
    name = "Estimate\n(X4 vs R5)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Selected CD4+ T-cell Subpopulations – Discovery Cohort (X4 vs R5)",
    x = "Subpopulation Marker", y = "Main Cell Type",
    caption = paste(
      "**: Significant in both Discovery & Validation (same direction)\n",
      "*^: Discovery significant, Validation not (same direction)\n",
      "*#: Discovery significant, Validation not (opposite direction)\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
```

#correlation plot for Treg-PD1 (95 CI) 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Correlation plots: Treg_PD1 vs selected variables
# - Exports Pearson r, 95% CI, p-value to Excel
# - Builds overall and tropism-stratified plots
# - Safely handles log10 axes by filtering non-positive values
# - Fixes duplicated "parse" warning from stat_cor()
# ============================================================

# ---- 1) Libraries ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(writexl)
  library(tibble)
  library(grid)
})

# ---- 2) Set up output directory ----
output_dir <- "R:/hcrc/Personal folders/Kavita Mehta/2000HIV/2000HIV_Flow/Percentage/correlation"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}



# ---- 4) Define variables ----
pd1_col <- "Panel2_2124"

plot_cols <- c(
  "Panel2_2298",      # Treg_HLA-DR+
  "Panel2_2240",      # Treg_CD38+
  "Panel2_2356",      # Treg_CCR4+
  "CD4_LATEST",
  "Total_million_avg",
  "Rainbow_DSI",
  "longLTR_cp_Mio",
  "POL_cp_Mio"
)

# ---- 5) Tropism colors ----
trop_colors <- c(R5 = "aquamarine3", X4 = "coral", Mixed = "steelblue3")

# ---- 6) Variables requiring log10 x-axis ----
exp_vars <- c("Total_million_avg", "Rainbow_DSI", "longLTR_cp_Mio","POL_cp_Mio")

# ---- 7) Friendly labels ----
rename_map <- c(
  Panel2_2298 = "Treg_HLA-DR+",
  Panel2_2124 = "Treg_PD1",
  Panel2_2240 = "Treg_CD38+",
  Panel2_2356 = "Treg_CCR4+",
  CD4_LATEST = "CD4 latest",
  Total_million_avg = "Total HIV DNA",
  Rainbow_DSI = "Intact HIV DNA",
  longLTR_cp_Mio ="longLTR_RNA",
  POL_cp_Mio = "POL_RNA"
)

# ---- 8) Helper: safe complete-case dataset for correlation ----
get_cor_df <- function(data, xvar, yvar, log_x = FALSE) {
  out <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[xvar]]), !is.na(.data[[yvar]]))

  if (log_x) {
    out <- out %>% filter(.data[[xvar]] > 0)
  }

  out
}

# ---- 9) Helper: safe Pearson correlation with 95% CI ----
get_cor_results <- function(data, xvar, yvar, log_x = FALSE) {
  sub <- get_cor_df(data, xvar, yvar, log_x = log_x)

  n_complete <- nrow(sub)

  if (n_complete < 4) return(NULL)
  if (sd(sub[[xvar]]) == 0 || sd(sub[[yvar]]) == 0) return(NULL)

  ct <- cor.test(
    sub[[xvar]],
    sub[[yvar]],
    method = "pearson",
    conf.level = 0.95
  )

  list(
    N = n_complete,
    r = unname(ct$estimate),
    CI_lower_95 = unname(ct$conf.int[1]),
    CI_upper_95 = unname(ct$conf.int[2]),
    p_value = ct$p.value
  )
}

# ---- 10) Helper: pretty log10 breaks based on actual data ----
get_log_breaks <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & !is.na(x) & x > 0]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NULL)

  min_exp <- floor(log10(min(x)))
  max_exp <- ceiling(log10(max(x)))
  10^(min_exp:max_exp)
}

# ---- 11) Results table ----
results <- tibble(
  FriendlyName = character(),
  Variable     = character(),
  Tropism      = character(),
  N            = numeric(),
  r            = double(),
  CI_lower_95  = double(),
  CI_upper_95  = double(),
  p_value      = double()
)

# ---- 12) Lists to collect plots ----
overall_list <- list()
group_list   <- list()

# ---- 13) Main loop ----
for (col in plot_cols) {

  if (!col %in% names(merged_data)) {
    warning("Skipping ", col, ": not found in merged_data.")
    next
  }

  log_x <- col %in% exp_vars

  x_lab <- if (col %in% names(rename_map)) rename_map[[col]] else col
  y_lab <- if (pd1_col %in% names(rename_map)) rename_map[[pd1_col]] else pd1_col

  # ---------------- Correlation results: overall ----------------
  ct_all <- get_cor_results(merged_data, col, pd1_col, log_x = log_x)

  if (!is.null(ct_all)) {
    results <- results %>%
      add_row(
        FriendlyName = x_lab,
        Variable     = col,
        Tropism      = "Overall",
        N            = ct_all$N,
        r            = ct_all$r,
        CI_lower_95  = ct_all$CI_lower_95,
        CI_upper_95  = ct_all$CI_upper_95,
        p_value      = ct_all$p_value
      )
  }

  # ---------------- Correlation results: by tropism ----------------
  for (g in names(trop_colors)) {
    sub_g <- merged_data %>% filter(Tropism == g)
    ct_g <- get_cor_results(sub_g, col, pd1_col, log_x = log_x)

    if (!is.null(ct_g)) {
      results <- results %>%
        add_row(
          FriendlyName = x_lab,
          Variable     = col,
          Tropism      = g,
          N            = ct_g$N,
          r            = ct_g$r,
          CI_lower_95  = ct_g$CI_lower_95,
          CI_upper_95  = ct_g$CI_upper_95,
          p_value      = ct_g$p_value
        )
    }
  }

  # ---------------- Plot data ----------------
  plot_df <- merged_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[col]]), !is.na(.data[[pd1_col]]), !is.na(Tropism))

  if (log_x) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>% filter(.data[[col]] > 0)
  }

  # if too few rows, skip plotting
  if (nrow(plot_df) < 4) {
    warning("Skipping plot for ", col, ": too few complete observations.")
    next
  }

  # x-axis breaks for log plots
  log_breaks <- NULL
  if (log_x) {
    log_breaks <- get_log_breaks(plot_df[[col]])
  }

  # ---------------- Theme ----------------
  my_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.title   = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text    = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.text  = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title   = element_text(color = "black", hjust = 0.5)
    )

  title_overall <- sprintf("%s vs %s", y_lab, x_lab)
  title_group   <- sprintf("%s vs %s", y_lab, x_lab)

 
  # ---------------- Overall plot ----------------
  p_overall <- ggplot(plot_df, aes_string(x = col, y = pd1_col)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Tropism), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  stat_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,                 # <-- enables 95% CI shading
    color = "black",
    fill = "grey40",
    alpha = 0.3, 
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  stat_cor(
    aes(label = after_stat(paste(r.label, p.label, sep = "~`,`~"))),
    method = "pearson",
    label.x.npc = 0.52,
    label.y.npc = "top",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = trop_colors) +
  labs(title = title_overall, x = x_lab, y = y_lab, color = "Tropism") +
  my_theme

  # ---------------- Grouped plot ----------------
  # ---------------- Grouped plot ----------------
p_group <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes_string(x = col, y = pd1_col, color = "Tropism", group = "Tropism")
) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  stat_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,                 # <-- 95% CI shading
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  stat_cor(
    aes(label = after_stat(paste(r.label, p.label, sep = "~`,`~"))),
    method = "pearson",
    size = 3,
    label.x.npc = 0.52,
    label.y.npc = 0.99
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = trop_colors) +
  labs(title = title_group, x = x_lab, y = y_lab, color = "Tropism") +
  my_theme

  # ---------------- Log10 scale if needed ----------------
  if (log_x && !is.null(log_breaks) && length(log_breaks) > 0) {
    p_overall <- p_overall +
      scale_x_log10(
        breaks = log_breaks,
        labels = function(x) as.expression(lapply(log10(x), function(e) bquote(10^.(e))))
      )

    p_group <- p_group +
      scale_x_log10(
        breaks = log_breaks,
        labels = function(x) as.expression(lapply(log10(x), function(e) bquote(10^.(e))))
      )
  }

  # ---------------- Store plots ----------------
  overall_list[[x_lab]] <- p_overall
  group_list[[x_lab]]   <- p_group
}

# ---- 14) Add formatted CI column ----
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    CI_95 = paste0("(", round(CI_lower_95, 3), ", ", round(CI_upper_95, 3), ")")
  )

# ---- 15) Export correlations to Excel ----
write_xlsx(
  results,
  path = file.path(output_dir, "TregPD1_correlations_with_95CI.xlsx")
)

# ---- 16) Add margins if enough plots exist ----
n_overall <- length(overall_list)
n_group   <- length(group_list)

if (n_overall >= 3) {
  for (i in 1:min(3, n_overall)) {
    overall_list[[i]] <- overall_list[[i]] +
      theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0.5, 0), "cm"))
  }
}
if (n_group >= 3) {
  for (i in 1:min(3, n_group)) {
    group_list[[i]] <- group_list[[i]] +
      theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0.5, 0), "cm"))
  }
}

if (n_overall >= 6) {
  for (i in 4:min(6, n_overall)) {
    overall_list[[i]] <- overall_list[[i]] +
      theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0, 0, 0), "cm"))
  }
}
if (n_group >= 6) {
  for (i in 4:min(6, n_group)) {
    group_list[[i]] <- group_list[[i]] +
      theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0, 0, 0), "cm"))
  }
}

# ---- 17) Arrange plots ----
multi_overall <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = overall_list,
  ncol     = 4,
  nrow     = 2,
  align    = "hv",
  widths   = rep(1, 3),
  heights  = rep(1, 3)
)

multi_tropism <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = group_list,
  ncol     = 4,
  nrow     = 2,
  align    = "hv",
  widths   = rep(1, 3),
  heights  = rep(1, 3)
)

# ---- 18) Save TIFF ----
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "tregPD1_overall.tiff"),
  plot     = multi_overall,
  width    = 12,
  height   = 8,
  dpi      = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "tregPD1_tropism.tiff"),
  plot     = multi_tropism,
  width    = 12,
  height   = 8,
  dpi      = 300
)

# ---- 19) Save PDF ----
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "tregPD1_overall.pdf"),
  plot     = multi_overall,
  device   = "pdf",
  width    = 18,
  height   = 8
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "tregPD1_tropism.pdf"),
  plot     = multi_tropism,

  width    = 18,
  height   = 8
)
```
